The role requires someone who is detail oriented, a team player, flexible, and a self-starter with strong interpersonal skills. You will need to manage assignments with urgency, drive completion efficiently, prioritize and execute multiple tasks, and demonstrate good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: configuring BOMs/routings for PCBAs/systems in accordance with product structure, standards, and internal procedures; development and implementation of tooling and processes; MPI development and shop travelers; and submitting them through the ECO into [Product name masked] environment.
cond_0528.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS in Engineering discipline with minimum six years of experience or equivalent supporting PCBA processes
Working knowledge of automated pick-and-place machines, reflow oven profiling, stencil printing equipment, wave soldering, and tooling design
Strong background in SMT processes and process development, with the ability to serve as a technical representative
Understanding of RoHS Directive, SPC, PFMEA, DOE, and Lean manufacturing
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Box Build/System integration
